mapper.sql: SELECT c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.annual_fee, c.card_issue_url, c.prev_month_spending, cc.company_id, cc.company_name, b.benefit_id, b.benefit_title, b.benefit_summary, b.benefit_description, b.benefit_icon_url, cat.category_id, cat.category_name, cat.category_image_url FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_company cc ON c.company_id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON c.card_id = b.card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.benefit_id = bc.benefit_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON bc.category_id = cat.category_id
mapper.select: SELECT c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.annual_fee, c.card_issue_url, cc.company_id, cc.company_name, b.benefit_id, b.benefit_summary, cat.category_id, cat.category_name, cat.category_image_url FROM user_card uc INNER JOIN card c on uc.card_id = c.card_id LEFT JOIN card_company cc ON c.company_id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON c.card_id = b.card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.benefit_id = bc.benefit_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON bc.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_deactivate = false ORDER BY c.card_name;
